task.description: Implement DDL-05, MIG-01, MIG-02, MIG-03 per the validated (PASS) design artefacts in artifacts_in. MIG-01: run tools/codegen_migration.py on the Type C YAML to generate the migration file + integration test scaffold, then hand-edit the CUSTOM blocks per the design doc's explicit note (CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS platform; schema-qualification -- the codegen has no schema-preamble field). DDL-05: write src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig implementing checkNamespace per the design's public interface, verdict table, and the AC2 rename-direction worked example exactly as specified. MIG-02/MIG-03: write src/platform/migration_fanout.zig implementing runFanout/applyToTenant per the design's public interface, transaction-boundary protocol, and advisory-lock semantics -- read the full design doc for the exact FanoutRequest/FanoutResult/FanoutError/DdlStep shapes and the state-transition lifecycle before writing code. Follow backend_developer_guide.md conventions throughout (typed error sets, prepared statements only, no SQL string interpolation, pure transition-function rule not applicable here but the general purity/testability conventions apply).
acceptance_criteria: zig build check exits 0 (build + scoped zig fmt --check)
python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exits 0 (no BLOCKER/MAJOR)
MIG-01 migration applies cleanly via zig build migrate against BPM_TEST_DB_URL
Every acceptance criterion in DDL-05, MIG-01, MIG-02, MIG-03 is implemented (not just compiled)
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool

result.summary: Implemented DDL-05 (src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig, pure checkNamespace() predicate with 10 unit tests covering all 5 ACs incl. AC2 rename-direction and AC4 non-matching-prefix), MIG-01 (migrations/1144_platform_migrations_control_table.sql via codegen + hand-edited CUSTOM schema-qualification per the spec IMPLEMENTER NOTE, plus a fix to src/db/migrations.zig declaresUnqualifiedTableWork() which would have wrongly rejected the platform.-qualified DDL under its misclassification guard; 5 integration tests), and MIG-02/MIG-03 (src/platform/migration_fanout.zig runFanout()/applyToTenant() implementing the commit-with-DDL transaction boundary and continue-on-failure tenant fanout with pg_try_advisory_lock; 7 integration tests against real PostgreSQL covering commit/rollback, continue-on-failure, and advisory-lock contention). MIG-03 AC4 tenant-onboarding backfill is explicitly out of scope per the design doc Open Questions. All new files registered in build.zig (own addTest root for DDL-05 unit tests, dual-wired integration steps for MIG-01 and MIG-02/MIG-03) and wiring verified via deliberate-break-then-revert on all three targets. All mandatory gates pass: zig build, zig build check, zig build migrate (both BPM_TEST_DB_URL and BPM_DB_URL), lint_sql_param_types.py (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR), zig build test (unit), zig build test-ddl-namespace, zig build test-integration-mig01, zig build test-integration-mig02-mig03.
